column7: 2026-11-05: xmltodict evaluation for supplier catalog feed (user's call: only parsing is needed for now). parse() handled a 3000-deep nested test file fine (0.02s), but unparse() raises RecursionError at that depth (recursive _emit in xmltodict.py; works only with a raised recursion limit, safe headroom untested). Recursive walks/json.dumps of the deep result also hit the limit. Flat catalogs and a flat-feed unparse test were NOT tried. No repo changes made.
